searchText: What's the difference between https://github.com/crate-crypto/go-eth-kzg and https://github.com/crate-crypto/go-kzg-4844 ? Hey, go-kzg-4844 contains the audited code for just 4844. go-eth-kzg extends and refactors it to include peerdas code So go-eth-kzg is an unaudited superset Do you intend to audit go-eth-kzg and replace go-kzg-4844 going forward? cc <@976542403269910539> yep
